cases.description: The final stir must add bowlSum to u; orderNumber only selects the permutation. A deliberately old-like formula using orderNumber for u must disagree.
Candidates above 5,778 days are diagnostic probes only and must be excluded before cardinality/selection.
Small month-weaving domains are enumerated independently from the production counter.
Foundation external representations remain anchored to committed scroll values; host-only APIs are not normative.
Three old-like witnesses can agree with one another and still lose to the independent reference.
